tableInfo.name: 患者放射線検査結果
tableInfo.sqlForTool: WITH CONVERT_HISTORY AS( select * from sync_convert_history a inner join sync_convert_history_dtl b on (a.seq_no=b.seq_no) where table_kind = 'EXM' ) {NoWITHIndTimePeriod} select a.PATID, a.PATID as FN_PAT_ID, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(a.EXAM_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss'),'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') as EXAM_DATE, a.EXAM_SET_CD, case a.EXAM_DIVISION when '0' then '1' when '1' then '2' when '2' then '0' end as EXAM_DIVISION, trim(a.DOCTOR_CODE) as DOCTOR_CODE, trim(a.ORDER_STAFF) as ORDER_STAFF, trim(a.UPDATE_CODE) as UPDATE_CODE, 0 as RAD_STATUS, '' as ORDER_RAD_SET_INFO, a.UP_DATE, CASE EXAM_PROC_CD WHEN '1' THEN '0'ELSE '1'END EXAM_PROC_CD from PAT_EXAMIN_SCHEDULE a {IndTimePeriodWhere} where not exists( select * from PAT_EXAMIN_SCHEDULE b where a.PATID=b.PATID and a.EXAM_DATE=b.EXAM_DATE and a.EXAM_SET_CD=b.EXAM_SET_CD and a.EXAM_DIVISION=b.EXAM_DIVISION and a.UP_DATE<b.UP_DATE) and substr(a.EXAM_SET_CD,1,1)='X' and exists(select * from PAT_INDEX_INFO c where a.PATID=c.PATID and PAT_STATUS='0') {sqlForSpecifyPeriod} {sqlForExclusiveOutputted} {sqlForSync} order by a.PATID,EXAM_DATE,EXAM_SET_CD,EXAM_DIVISION
tableInfo.sqlForExclusiveOutputted: and not exists( select * from CONVERT_HISTORY ch where ch.facility_cd=:facility_cd {sqlForSync} and a.patid=ch.CONVERTTS and ch.table_kind = 'EXM' and a.EXAM_DATE >= ch.start_date and a.EXAM_DATE < ch.end_date + 1)
